parsed.summary: The three sheets were checked against the specification and no deviation could be substantiated. Every reference designator and value matches the spec (R1/R2/R3 = 10k NFC pull-ups, R4/R6/R7 = 10k display pull-ups, R5 = 390k IREF, R8 = 1k TSC series, R10 = 10k NRST pull-up; C1/C9 = 4.7µF, C2–C6/C8 = 100nF, C7 = 2.2µF, C10/C17 = 1µF, C11 = 4.7µF, C12/C13 = 1µF, C14 = 22nF, C18 = '??' as documented), and the visible connectivity (NFC 2-wire bus + FD pull-up to VCC, SSD1306 I2C strapping/reset and charge-pump network, TSC electrode + sampling capacitor, NRST/BOOT0, and decoupling) agrees with the specified topology, so no supported anomaly was found.
